title: bot.ability.vision.detection.input
description: One encoded image to find objects in.

image.description: The image, exactly as its source encoded it: a reference (a URI reference) to the image file in the media directory the run grants, never bytes [floppy field].
image.title: Image

media_type.description: Media type of the encoded bytes, such as image/png, image/jpeg or image/webp; null when the source did not name it. The original carries it inside its image [floppy field].
media_type.title: Media Type
